item.title: How to get your attention span back
item.description: In a world with endless emails, DMs, alerts, and notifications, it can feel impossible to concentrate. Here’s how you can rebuild your attention span. We live in a world of distraction. In the time it took me to write this sentence, I got a new email alert on my computer, two new DMs, and an alert on my phone that my Duolingo streak is in jeopardy. With all of this outside interference, how in the world do you manage to sustain attention on anything anymore?...

item.title: The goal of every meeting should be a decision
item.description: If your meetings feel like a waste of time, adding more meetings isn’t the answer. A better fix is focusing on decision-making. Nothing quite triggers a collective exhale like the “ding” of a canceled meeting. These days, people have come to dread meetings. It’s no wonder companies are getting creative in their attempts to revamp them, from starting with coloring sessions to holding them on basketball courts (while shooting hoops) and more....
